title: Demo Addins Bank: Operator-visible packs
description: Create a bank of low-gravity demo add-ins that prove install → visible effect → uninstall without requiring backlog/provider semantics.
rationale: We need compelling demos for Addins while the deeper capability model matures. Focus on static contributions and safe deployment.
success_criteria: Add-in installs cleanly via registry entry
Operator UI shows installed add-in state
notes: Demo-focused work items for validating the Addins framework without kernel pollution.

title: Addin Installer & Deployment Hardening
description: Harden the add-in installer to reliably deploy extracted artifacts into project roots using manifest deploy mappings.
rationale: Addins must be deterministic, auditable, and not rely on cache paths. Deployment correctness is foundational for every add-in type.
success_criteria: Add-in installs cleanly via registry entry
Operator UI shows installed add-in state
notes: Demo-focused work items for validating the Addins framework without kernel pollution.

title: Addin Registry & Trust Signals (Demo-ready)
description: Make the registry and installed state understandable: versioning, digests, and simple trust indicators for demos.
rationale: Demos must show provenance and lifecycle controls (install, enable, disable, uninstall) without executing add-in code.
success_criteria: Add-in installs cleanly via registry entry
Operator UI shows installed add-in state
notes: Demo-focused work items for validating the Addins framework without kernel pollution.

title: Theme Pack Addin (v1)
description: Install a theme pack add-in that changes operator console branding via static tokens/assets.
acceptance_criteria: Feature is delivered entirely via add-in contributions (no provider-specific kernel code)
Feature is visible/auditable from Operator UI (installed, enabled, versioned)
Feature works offline with static add-in artifacts (no add-in runtime execution)
notes: Keep it boring and demonstrable. Prioritise install → visible effect → uninstall.

title: Agent Role Pack Addin (v1)

acceptance_criteria: Feature is delivered entirely via add-in contributions (no provider-specific kernel code)

Feature works offline with static add-in artifacts (no add-in runtime execution)
